Dish Name: Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney & Sambhar
Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (6g), Potassium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Parboiled rice, Urad dal, Methi seeds, Boiled potatoes, Onions, Green chillies, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, Turmeric, Sesame oil / Coconut oil, Coconut, Chana dal, Toor dal, Sambhar powder, Tamarind pulp
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind fermented rice-urad dal batter and spread thinly on hot tawa. 2. Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, onions, green chillies, turmeric, and mix with mashed potatoes for filling. 3. Place potato masala inside dosa, fold, and serve with freshly ground coconut chutney and hot vegetable sambhar.

Dish Name: Jain Plain Dosa with Coconut Chutney & Sambhar
Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Rice, Urad dal, Methi seeds, Coconut, Roasted chana dal (Dalia), Green chillies, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, Hing (Asafoetida), Toor dal, Yellow pumpkin, Bottle gourd, Tamarind, Sambhar powder, Ghee / Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Spread fermented batter into crisp thin dosas on hot tawa. 2. Prepare chutney by grinding coconut, roasted chana dal, green chillies, hing, and salt (tempered with mustard and curry leaves). 3. Cook sambhar using toor dal, pumpkin, bottle gourd, tamarind, and hing (no onion, garlic, or root vegetables).

Key Nutrients: Protein (11g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (7g), Iron, Folate
Ingredients Required: Idli rice, Whole Urad dal (white), Whole Black Pepper, Cumin seeds, Ginger, Green chillies, Curry leaves, Oil for deep frying, Sambhar ingredients
Recipe Instructions: 1. Steam fermented idli batter in molds for 10-12 mins until fluffy. 2. Coarsely grind soaked urad dal with peppercorns, cumin, curry leaves, and green chillies; shape into donut vada discs and deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Serve hot with sambhar and chutneys.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (11g), Carbohydrates (36g), Fiber (2g), Vitamin B12, Choline
Ingredients Required: Raw rice, Cooked rice, Coconut milk, Yeast/Tender coconut water, Eggs, Crushed black pepper, Salt, Coconut oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind raw rice, cooked rice, and coconut milk into a smooth batter; ferment overnight with yeast/coconut water. 2. Swirl batter in a hot curved Appachatti pan to create lacy edges and soft center. 3. Crack a fresh egg into center, sprinkle black pepper and salt, cover and steam till egg white sets.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (64g), Fiber (7g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Basmati rice, Mixed vegetables (Carrots, Beans, Peas, Potatoes), Curd, Fried onions (Birista), Mint, Coriander, Saffron milk, Ghee, Whole biryani spices, Ginger-garlic paste
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate vegetables in curd, ginger-garlic paste, birista, mint, and whole biryani spices. 2. Parboil fragrant basmati rice with whole spices. 3. Layer marinated veggies and rice in heavy pot, top with saffron ghee, seal with dough, and cook on 'Dum' for 25 mins.

Dish Name: Jain South Indian Meals (Sambar Rice & Rasam)
Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (66g), Fiber (8g), Vit C, Iron
Ingredients Required: Sona Masoori Rice, Toor dal, Yellow pumpkin, Beans, Raw banana, Tomatoes, Tamarind, Rasam powder, Sambhar powder, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, Hing, Ghee
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pressure cook toor dal. 2. Prepare Sambhar with tamarind extract, hing, pumpkin, beans, cooked dal, and sambhar powder. 3. Prepare Rasam by boiling tomato puree, tamarind, rasam powder, hing, and tempering with ghee, mustard seeds, and curry leaves. Serve over hot rice.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (8g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Rice, Toor dal, Carrots, Beans, Peas, Kapok buds (Maratti moggu), Byadgi chillies, Chana dal, Urad dal, Cinnamon, Cloves, Fresh coconut, Tamarind, Jaggery, Ghee, Cashews
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roast Byadgi chillies, lentils, and spices; grind with coconut to make fresh Bisi Bele Bath powder. 2. Pressure cook rice, toor dal, and vegetables together. 3. Mix cooked rice-dal with tamarind pulp, jaggery, and spice paste. Temper cashews and mustard seeds in ghee and pour over.

Key Nutrients: Protein (36g), Fat (30g), Carbohydrates (12g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Zinc, Vit B6
Ingredients Required: Chicken, Shallots (Small onions), Tomatoes, Roasted Kalpasi (Stone flower), Star anise, Fennel seeds, Black peppercorns, Dry red chillies, Fresh coconut, Curry leaves, Gingelly oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Dry roast whole peppercorns, fennel, coriander, dry chillies, stone flower, and coconut; grind into a rich Chettinad masala paste. 2. Heat gingelly oil, temper curry leaves and shallots. 3. Add chicken, spice paste, tomatoes, and simmer on low flame until meat is tender and dark peppery oil separates.

Key Nutrients: Protein (42g), Fat (36g), Carbohydrates (58g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Zinc, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Mutton meat, Aged Basmati rice, Raw papaya paste, Thick curd, Fried onions (Birista), Mint, Cilantro, Green chillies, Shahi jeera, Saffron, Desi Ghee, Whole spices
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate raw mutton in papaya paste, curd, ginger-garlic, mint, spices, and birista for 4 hours. 2. Parboil basmati rice to 70% with whole spices. 3. Layer raw marinated mutton at bottom, cover with rice, drizzle saffron milk and ghee. Seal pot with dough and Dum-cook on slow heat for 45 mins.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (28g), Fiber (6g), Iron, Folate
Ingredients Required: Whole white Urad dal, Whole Black peppercorns, Green chillies, Ginger, Curry leaves, Fresh coconut, Hing, Oil for deep frying, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak urad dal for 2 hours and grind into a thick, fluffy batter using minimal water. 2. Mix crushed peppercorns, green chillies, ginger, hing, and curry leaves. 3. Shape into donuts and deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. Serve with coconut chutney.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Fermented Dosa batter, Red chilli-chana dal paste (without garlic/onion), Boiled raw banana mash, Green chillies, Turmeric, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, Butter / Ghee
Recipe Instructions: 1. Spread fermented batter on hot tawa; smear red chilli-hing paste generously inside. 2. Add spiced boiled raw banana mash filling in center. 3. Drizzle butter around edges, cook till crispy dark golden, fold and serve with Jain coconut chutney.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (4g), Energy
Ingredients Required: Idli/Dosa batter, Chopped onions, Green chillies, Mustard seeds, Chana dal, Curry leaves, Coconut oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Temper mustard seeds, chana dal, chopped onions, chillies, and curry leaves in oil; mix into fermented batter. 2. Drizzle oil into spherical cavities of a hot Paniyaram pan. 3. Pour batter, cook covered until bottom turns golden crisp, flip and cook top side.

Key Nutrients: Protein (34g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (16g), Fiber (2g), Omega-3, Vit D
Ingredients Required: Seer Fish / Kingfish steaks (Anjal), Byadgi chillies, Tamarind paste, Garlic, Cumin seeds, Turmeric, Semolina (Chiroti Rava), Coconut oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind soaked Byadgi chillies, garlic, cumin, tamarind, and salt into thick red paste. 2. Generously marinate fish steaks for 30 minutes. 3. Coat coated steaks in fine semolina (rava) and shallow fry in coconut oil until golden and crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Maida flour, Oil/Ghee, Mixed vegetables (Peas, Carrots, Beans, Potatoes), Coconut paste, Fennel seeds, Cashews, Green chillies, Poppy seeds, Ginger-garlic, Whole spices
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead, oil, rest, roll, coil, and flatten maida dough; cook on tawa and crush with hands to separate flaky layers (Malabar Parotta). 2. Grind coconut, cashews, fennel, and green chillies. 3. Sauté spices, veggies, ginger-garlic, add coconut paste and simmer until aromatic.

Dish Name: Jain Appam with Coconut Milk (Paal Appam)
Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (3g), Calcium, Energy
Ingredients Required: Raw rice, Thick Coconut milk, Cardamom powder, Sugar, Salt, Water
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind soaked rice with fresh coconut water into smooth batter; let ferment naturally. 2. Pour batter in curved appam pan and swirl to get thin lacy edges with soft spongy center. 3. Serve hot with sweetened thick coconut milk flavored with cardamom.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (9g), Vit A, Vit C, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Drumsticks, Raw banana, Elephant foot yam, Carrots, Beans, Snake gourd, Fresh coconut paste, Green chillies, Cumin seeds, Curd (Yogurt), Coconut oil, Fresh Curry leaves, Kerala Matta Rice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook batons of mixed vegetables with turmeric, green chillies, and salt. 2. Coarsely grind coconut and cumin seeds; fold into cooked vegetables. 3. Turn off heat, stir in sour curd, drizzle fresh cold-pressed coconut oil and bruised curry leaves. Serve with boiled Matta red rice.

Dish Name: Jain Veg Avial with Matta Rice
Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (9g), Vit A, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Drumsticks, Raw banana, Ash gourd, Carrots, Beans, Snake gourd, Fresh coconut, Cumin seeds, Green chillies, Curd, Coconut oil, Curry leaves, Matta Rice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slice non-root vegetables (drumstick, raw banana, ash gourd, beans, carrots) into long strips and steam with salt and turmeric. 2. Fold coarsely ground coconut, green chillies, and cumin paste into cooked veggies. 3. Remove from heat, mix thick curd, drizzle raw coconut oil, and curry leaves.

Key Nutrients: Protein (32g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (8g), Fiber (2g), Omega-3, Vit D
Ingredients Required: Kingfish / Pomfret, Kudampuli (Malabar Tamarind), Shallots, Garlic, Ginger, Kashmiri red chilli powder, Turmeric, Fenugreek seeds, Coconut oil, Curry leaves
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak Kudampuli in warm water. 2. In a clay pot (Meen Chatti), heat coconut oil, temper fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, shallots, ginger, and garlic. 3. Add chilli powder and turmeric paste, Kudampuli water, and fish steaks. Simmer on low flame till gravy darkens and thickens.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (26g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (1g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Besan (Gram flour), Pure Desi Ghee, Sugar, Water
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare 1-string sugar syrup. 2. Sift besan and gradually add to boiling syrup while whisking continuously. 3. Pour hot melted desi ghee in streams while stirring vigorously until mixture turns frothy and porous. Pour into greased tray, set, and slice into slabs.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (2g), Potassium, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Tender coconut pulp (Elaneer), Tender coconut water, Condensed milk, Full-cream Milk, Cardamom powder, Ghee-roasted cashews
Recipe Instructions: 1. Blend half the tender coconut pulp into a smooth paste and chop remaining into small bites. 2. Boil milk with condensed milk until slightly reduced; cool completely. 3. Fold in coconut paste, tender coconut bites, coconut water, cardamom, and roasted cashews. Chill before serving.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (1g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Bread slices (crusts removed), Desi Ghee for frying, Milk, Khoya, Sugar, Saffron strands, Cardamom powder, Slivered almonds, Pistachios, Cashews
Recipe Instructions: 1. Deep fry bread triangles in desi ghee till golden brown and crisp. 2. Reduce milk with khoya, sugar, cardamom, and saffron into Rabri. 3. Arrange fried bread in a baking dish, pour hot rabri over it till absorbed, garnish with nuts, and bake briefly.

Key Nutrients: Protein (3g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (2g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Rice Ada (steamed rice flakes), Jaggery (Gur), Thin & Thick Coconut milk, Dry ginger powder (Chukku), Cardamom powder, Coconut bites fried in coconut oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil rice ada until soft and drain. 2. Melt jaggery and cook soft ada in jaggery syrup till thick. 3. Add thin coconut milk and simmer, then turn off heat and stir in thick coconut milk, cardamom, dry ginger, and fried coconut bites.
